snippet.title: Metroid Prime 2 Better Echoes: FULL PLAYTHROUGH
snippet.description:
Introducing Better Echoes! A playable mod of Metroid Prime 2!

Metroid Prime 2 has long been one of my favorite games. In fact, it may just be my #1 favorite game, period. However, I'm still *fully* aware of its various flaws. Games have come a long way in the over two decades since it released, and modern gaming standards would really do a lot to improve Echoes.

So, I decided to do just that! I think, after playing or watching this mod, anyone can agree just how much Better this makes the game.

Download link (requires an NTSC GameCube Metroid Prime 2 ISO to use):
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1y9Zj9BhdRSzhZ9yntEWYwrpOthkZMjy4/
